text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
As the Classic Year's spring GⅠ campaign 
approached, Mejiro Ardan proposed making 
the Nippon Derby her primary goal.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She held a fierce desire to eclipse the 
dazzling hoofprints of her great sister 
that cast a shadow over her, and leave her 
own trail of light as Mejiro Ardan.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
To maximize her chances of winning the 
Japanese Derby, the Aoba Sho was chosen as 
her prep race. Steeling her resolve, she 
set off once more, but...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Meanwhile, Mejiro Ardan was keenly aware 
of the rise of Sakura Chiyono O and Yaeno 
Muteki in the Classic class.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
However, asserting that her greatest goal 
was to surpass her sister's legacy, she 
refocused her efforts toward the Aoba 
Sho...
